greet-the-townsfolk.name: Greet the Townsfolk
greet-the-townsfolk.description:
I'm sure you've met some of your neighbors already, but wouldn't it be nice to say hello to everyone?
Don't be shy, introduce yourself!
greet-the-townsfolk.requirementsToComplete: Talk to the 22 townsfolk in Mistria and then talk to Adeline.

museum-donations-wanted.name: Museum Donations Wanted
museum-donations-wanted.description: Errol sent me a letter telling me to meet him at the Museum west of town. He says he is the new curator and wants to talk to me about donations.
museum-donations-wanted.source: Letter from Errol on Year 1, 2 Spring
museum-donations-wanted.requirementsToComplete: Meet Errol at The Museum in The Narrows.

do-a-bro-a-favor.name: Do a Bro a Favor
do-a-bro-a-favor.description:
Welcome to town!
Have you noticed that Mistria is full of rocks? I've got just the tool for dealing with them, and it's all yours if you can do me a favor!
Come talk to me for the details!

something's-bugging-me.name: Something's Bugging Me
something's-bugging-me.description:
I'm concerned that I never see anyone out catching bugs... I must do something about it!
Do YOU want to catch bugs for FUN and SCIENCE? Come to the Inn and I'll help you get started!

friday-at-the-sleeping-dragon-inn.name: Friday at the Sleeping Dragon Inn
friday-at-the-sleeping-dragon-inn.description: Reina asked me to meet her after 6 PM at the Sleeping Dragon Inn, for a Friday night gathering.
friday-at-the-sleeping-dragon-inn.source: Letter from Reina on Year 1, 5 Spring
friday-at-the-sleeping-dragon-inn.requirementsToComplete: Meet Reina at The Inn after 6 PM on a Friday.

seeking-gossip.name: Seeking Gossip
seeking-gossip.description: Do you have a nose for news? An ear for the exciting? I love Mistria, but I do miss all the gossip of the big city...
seeking-gossip.requirementsToComplete:
Talk to Balor, Juniper, and Dell to collect gossip.
Afterwards, tell Elsie what you learned.

the-state-of-the-mines.name: The State of the Mines
the-state-of-the-mines.description: Eiland asked me to meet him at the Museum to discuss reopening the Mines.
the-state-of-the-mines.source: Letter from Eiland on Year 1, 6 Spring
the-state-of-the-mines.requirementsToComplete: Meet Eiland at The Museum west of town.

unlocking-the-mines.name: Unlocking the Mines
unlocking-the-mines.description:
Errol has decided that we have improved the town enough to unlock the Mines!
Meet him and Eiland at the entrance of the Mines.
unlocking-the-mines.source: Letter from Errol after Town Rank is at least Town Rank Level 10, Stone and "The State of the Mines" is completed.
unlocking-the-mines.requirementsToReceive: Reach Town Rank Town Rank Level 10, Stone, Complete "The State of the Mines"
unlocking-the-mines.requirementsToComplete: Meet Errol and Eiland outside The Mines' entrance.

cop-some-ore.name: Cop Some Ore
cop-some-ore.description:
My ore shipment is running late, and my lazy brother won't go into the "condemned, super creepy mine" for me, so someone else has to do it!
Bring me 3 pieces of copper ore! Or don't! Whatever!
cop-some-ore.source: Letter from March, after The Mines are open.
cop-some-ore.requirementsToComplete:
Bring March some copper ore.
Copper Ore (3)

the-water-tablet.name: The Water Tablet
the-water-tablet.description:
I found a tablet with strange markings in the Mines. I'll need to figure out what it means before I can go any further.
Perhaps Eiland could help me translate it?
the-water-tablet.requirementsToComplete:
Offer the required items to the water seal:
Stone Loach
Upper Mines Mushroom
Ruby
Lantern Moth

the-earth-tablet.name: The Earth Tablet
the-earth-tablet.description: I found another tablet with strange markings in the Mines. I should bring it to Juniper to discuss our next steps.
the-earth-tablet.requirementsToComplete:
Offer the required items to the earth seal:
Coral Mantis
Sapphire
Archerfish
Jade Dulse

the-fire-tablet.name: The Fire Tablet
the-fire-tablet.description: I found another tablet with strange markings in the Mines. I should bring it to Juniper to discuss our next steps.

procuring-the-sealing-scroll.name: Procuring the Sealing Scroll
procuring-the-sealing-scroll.description: To break the next seal I will need four items, including a rare Sealing Scroll. Balor says he may be able to help me acquire one.
procuring-the-sealing-scroll.requirementsToComplete:
Wait for Balor to contact you with regards to the Sealing Scroll.
Meet Balor in his room.
Deposit the required items into the chest next to Balor's Wagon:
Ruby (10)
Sapphire (10)
Emerald (10)
Silver Ingot (10)

breaking-the-fire-seal.name: Breaking The Fire Seal
breaking-the-fire-seal.description: Juniper helped me translate the fire tablet. Now I need to offer the required items to break it.
breaking-the-fire-seal.requirementsToComplete:
Offer the required items to the fire seal:
Faceted Rock Gem
Rockroot
Emerald
Sealing Scroll

creating-the-void-mass.name: Creating The Void Mass
creating-the-void-mass.description: The Priestess told me I must gather materials to create a Void Mass that will allow me to safely open the Ruins Seal.
creating-the-void-mass.requirementsToComplete:
Offer the required items to the Cauldron in the Void Seal room.
Void Stone (5)
Void Powder (5)
Void Herb (5)
Void Pearl (5)

breaking-the-ruins-seal.name: Breaking The Ruins Seal
breaking-the-ruins-seal.description: The Priestess made the Void Decoy, now I need to offer the required items to break the seal.
breaking-the-ruins-seal.requirementsToComplete:
Break the Ruins Seal.
Breath of Flame
Smoke Moth
Firesail Fish
Obsidian

find-the-magic-key.name: Find The Magic Key
find-the-magic-key.description: To proceed further in the Ruins, I will need to find a Magic Key somewhere in the Priestess Quarters.
find-the-magic-key.requirementsToComplete:
Explore the Northwest Room in the Priestess Quarters.
Light the Dragon Forge in the southwest room.
Inspect the Library.
Offer a Temple Flower and a Marigold at the Priestess Tablet.
Grow the Seed of Balance in the Field Room.
Use the Magic Key to unlock the door in the Priestess Quarters.

the-dragonsworn-tablet.name: The Dragonsworn Tablet
the-dragonsworn-tablet.description: I must uncover the secret of the Dragonsworn Tablet.
the-dragonsworn-tablet.requirementsToComplete:
Investigate the Dragonsworn Tablet on Floor 100.
Reach 8 Hearts with Juniper & Eiland and view both 8-Heart events, then talk to Juniper.
Read the Dragonsworn Tablet.

breaking-the-final-seal.name: Breaking The Final Seal
breaking-the-final-seal.description: Juniper and Eiland helped me solve the mystery of the Dragonsworn Tablet. Now I need to offer the required items to break the Final Seal.
breaking-the-final-seal.requirementsToComplete:
Craft the necessary items at the Dragon Forge and offer them at the Dragonsworn Tablet to break the Final Seal.
Dragon-Forged Fang
Dragon-Forged Horn
Dragon-Forged Core
Dragon-Forged Powder

repair-the-bridge.name: Repair the Bridge
repair-the-bridge.description: Adeline requested my help in repairing the bridge on the Eastern Road.
repair-the-bridge.source: Letter from Adeline on Year 1, 3 Spring
repair-the-bridge.requirementsToComplete:
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box next to the bridge, then talk to Adeline.
Wood (60)
Stone (60)

greet-the-vendors.name: Greet the Vendors
greet-the-vendors.description: The Saturday Market is finally back! It's set up in the middle of town, around the big fountain. Visit all four vendors, and then report back to me!
greet-the-vendors.source: Letter from Nora after "Repair the Bridge" is completed.
greet-the-vendors.requirementsToComplete: Talk to Nora after you've introduced yourself to the vendors at the Saturday Market in town.

restocking-mistria's-food-reserves.name: Restocking Mistria's Food Reserves
restocking-mistria's-food-reserves.description: Adeline asked me to meet her at the Manor House to discuss Mistria's emergency supply reserves.
restocking-mistria's-food-reserves.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "Repair the Bridge"
restocking-mistria's-food-reserves.requirementsToComplete: Sell 10 crops, then talk to Adeline.

the-mill-restoration-project.name: The Mill Restoration Project
the-mill-restoration-project.description:
Adeline sent me an official-looking letter asking to meet her in her office at the Manor House.
Sounds like she wants my help restoring the old mill in town.
the-mill-restoration-project.source: Letter from Adeline, 3 days after completing "Restocking Mistria's Food Reserves"
the-mill-restoration-project.requirementsToReceive: Complete "Restocking Mistria's Food Reserves", and wait 3 days
the-mill-restoration-project.requirementsToComplete:
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside of the Mill, then bring Adeline 1,000t.
Wood (150)
Copper Ingot (2)
Stone (200)

beautification-project.name: Beautification Project
beautification-project.description: Adeline asked me to meet her in front of the Manor House to talk about our next project.
beautification-project.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "The Mill Restoration Project"
beautification-project.requirementsToComplete: Meet Adeline in front of the Manor House

repair-the-general-store.name: Repair the General Store
repair-the-general-store.description: Adeline asked me to meet her at the General Store to talk about "Phase 2" of her plan to revitalize Mistria.
repair-the-general-store.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "Beautification Project"
repair-the-general-store.requirementsToComplete:
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside of General Store, then bring Adeline 3,000t.
Stone (500)
Wood (300)
Copper Ingot (5)
Iron Ingot (5)

repair-the-beach-bridge.name: Repair the Beach Bridge
repair-the-beach-bridge.description: Terithia asked me to meet her and Adeline at the beach to work on a new project.
repair-the-beach-bridge.source: Letter from Terithia, after completing "Repair the General Store"
repair-the-beach-bridge.requirementsToComplete:
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box near Terithia's house, then bring 1,000t to Terithia.
Fiber (50)
Wood (300)
Stone (150)

restocking-mistria's-food-reserves-2.name: Restocking Mistria's Food Reserves 2
restocking-mistria's-food-reserves-2.description: Adeline asked me to meet her at Hayden's Farm to go over the plan for Mistria's food reserves.
restocking-mistria's-food-reserves-2.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "Repair the Beach Bridge"
restocking-mistria's-food-reserves-2.requirementsToComplete:
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside of the Inn, then talk to Adeline.
Chicken Egg (12)
Cheese (10)

upgrade-hayden's-barn.name: Upgrade Hayden's Barn
upgrade-hayden's-barn.description: Adeline asked me to meet her at Hayden's farm to work on a new project.
upgrade-hayden's-barn.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "Restocking Mistria's Food Reserves 2"
upgrade-hayden's-barn.requirementsToComplete:
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside of Hayden's barn, then bring 4,000t to Adeline.
Wood (400)
Stone (500)
Iron Ingot (8)

find-the-weathervane.name: Find the Weathervane
find-the-weathervane.description: Hayden asked me to find his weathervane that was blown away in the windstorm. He said it might be somewhere in the Narrows.
find-the-weathervane.source: Hayden, following the overnight windstorm after completing "Upgrade Hayden's Barn"
find-the-weathervane.requirementsToReceive: Complete "Upgrade Hayden's Barn", and wait 1 day
find-the-weathervane.requirementsToComplete:
Find Hayden's weathervane in The Narrows.
Hayden's Weathervane (1)

upgrade-the-inn.name: Upgrade the Inn
upgrade-the-inn.description: Adeline asked me to meet her at the Inn to talk about what's next for the town.
upgrade-the-inn.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "Upgrade Hayden's Barn"
upgrade-the-inn.requirementsToComplete:
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside of The Inn, then bring 6,000t to Adeline.
Silver Ingot (10)
Stone (500)
Glass (25)
Wood (600)
Peat (10)

stone-refinery.name: Stone Refinery
stone-refinery.description: Adeline said she had some exciting news to share from the King's Council. Are we improving the mines somehow?
stone-refinery.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "Upgrade The Inn" and reaching Town Rank Lvl. 55
stone-refinery.requirementsToReceive: Complete "Upgrade The Inn", reach Town Rank Lvl. 55
stone-refinery.requirementsToComplete:
Talk to Adeline, at the entrance to The Mines.
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside of The Mines, then bring 5,000t to Adeline
Wood (200)
Stone (400)
Sap (20)

upgrade-the-saturday-market.name: Upgrade the Saturday Market
upgrade-the-saturday-market.description: Adeline has some exciting news to share with me! I should go find her.
upgrade-the-saturday-market.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "Stone Refinery" and reaching Town Rank Lvl. 65
upgrade-the-saturday-market.requirementsToReceive: Complete "Stone Refinery", reach Town Rank Lvl. 65
upgrade-the-saturday-market.requirementsToComplete:
Talk to Adeline.
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside of the Manor House, then talk to Adeline
Crystal (20)
Gold Ingot (8)
Hard Wood (100)
Obsidian (20)
Refined Stone (50)

upgrade-the-carpenter's-shop.name: Upgrade the Carpenter's Shop
upgrade-the-carpenter's-shop.description: Adeline sent me a letter asking me to meet her at the Carpenter's Shop to talk about the next town upgrade.
upgrade-the-carpenter's-shop.source: Letter from Adeline, after completing "Upgrade the Saturday Market" and reaching Town Rank Lvl. 70
upgrade-the-carpenter's-shop.requirementsToReceive: Complete "Upgrade the Saturday Market", reach Town Rank Lvl. 70
upgrade-the-carpenter's-shop.requirementsToComplete:
Meet Adeline at the Carpenter's Shop.
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside of The Carpenter's Shop, then talk to Adeline
Crystal (30)
Glass (100)
Obsidian (30)
Refined Stone (100)

expanding-the-saturday-market.name: Expanding the Saturday Market
expanding-the-saturday-market.description: Meet Nora and Adeline at the Manor House to discuss expanding the Saturday Market
expanding-the-saturday-market.source: Letter from Nora, after completing "Upgrade the Carpenter's Shop" and reaching Town Rank Lvl. 80
expanding-the-saturday-market.requirementsToReceive:
Complete "Upgrade the Carpenter's Shop",
reach Town Rank Lvl. 80
expanding-the-saturday-market.requirementsToComplete:
Meet Nora and Adeline at the Manor House
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box at the Plaza west of the Blacksmiths, then talk to Adeline
Voidite (50)
Refined Stone (20)
Mistril Ingot (5)
Monster Core (10)
Monster Block (5)

meet-the-new-vendors.name: Meet the New Vendors
meet-the-new-vendors.description: Talk to Stillwell and Zorel at the Saturday Market.
meet-the-new-vendors.source: Letter from Nora, after completing "Expanding The Saturday Market"
meet-the-new-vendors.requirementsToComplete:
Meet Stillwell and Zorel at the Saturday Market
Talk to Nora

repair-the-bell-tower.name: Repair the Bell Tower
repair-the-bell-tower.description: Zorel sent me a letter asking me to help her repair the Bell Tower.
repair-the-bell-tower.source: Letter from Zorel, after completing "Meet the New Vendors" and reaching Town Rank Lvl. 90
repair-the-bell-tower.requirementsToReceive: Complete "Meet the New Vendors", reach Town Rank Lvl. 90
repair-the-bell-tower.requirementsToComplete:
Meet Zorel, Adeline and Landen at the Bell Tower to discuss its repair.
Deposit the required materials in the Donation Box outside the Bell Tower, then talk to Adeline.
Refined Stone (20)
Hardwood (30)
Dragon-Forged Fang (1)
Dragon-Forged Core (1)

the-spring-festival.name: The Spring Festival
the-spring-festival.description:
The Spring Festival is soon! Celine wants me to collect as much Breath of Spring as I can which can be found in variety of places around Mistria.
The more I collect, the better the festival will be!
the-spring-festival.source: Upon leaving your house every year on 14 Spring from Celine.
the-spring-festival.requirementsToComplete:
Collect Breath of Spring before the upcoming festival.
Visit The Spring Festival in the town square.

the-shooting-star-festival.name: The Shooting Star Festival
the-shooting-star-festival.description: Today is the Shooting Star Festival! I should head over to the summit at 8 PM to witness the gorgeous view. Elsie said that I should invite someone to go with me, as well.
the-shooting-star-festival.source: Upon leaving your house every year on 28 Summer from Elsie.
the-shooting-star-festival.requirementsToComplete: Visit The Shooting Star Festival at The Summit after 8 PM.

the-harvest-festival.name: The Harvest Festival
the-harvest-festival.description:
The Harvest Festival is soon! Reina wants me to collect as many Queen Berries as I can which can be found in variety of places around Mistria.
The more I collect, the better the festival will be!
the-harvest-festival.source: Upon leaving your house every year on 7 Fall from Reina.
the-harvest-festival.requirementsToComplete:
Collect Queen Berry before the upcoming festival.
Visit The Harvest Festival in the town square.

stinky-stamina-potion.name: Stinky Stamina Potion
stinky-stamina-potion.description: Attractive and extremely talented bathhouse owner seeks a gopher to find and hand over a Lilac.
stinky-stamina-potion.requirementsToComplete:
Bring a lilac to Juniper.
Lilac (1)

jo's-cooking-class.name: Jo's Cooking Class
jo's-cooking-class.description:
On your own for the first time and unsure how to feed yourself?
Come to the Sleeping Dragon Inn for a free cooking class with Josephine! Learn the ins and outs of cooking!
jo's-cooking-class.requirementsToComplete: Meet Josephine at the Sleeping Dragon Inn.

crafting-tutorial.name: Crafting Tutorial
crafting-tutorial.description: Ryis asked me to meet him to review crafting.
crafting-tutorial.source: Letter from Ryis on Year 1, 10 Spring

tea-with-hayden.name: Tea with Hayden
tea-with-hayden.description:
Can't thank you enough for your work on the mill, [Player]!
If you've got some time, come on over to my place. I'll put on the kettle and we can chat about ranching and raising animals!
tea-with-hayden.source: Letter from Hayden, after completing Story Quest "The Mill Restoration Project"
tea-with-hayden.requirementsToReceive: Complete Story Quest "The Mill Restoration Project"
tea-with-hayden.requirementsToComplete: Meet Hayden at his house west of your farm.

the-smell-of-drying-ink.name: The Smell of Drying Ink
the-smell-of-drying-ink.description: Adeline asked me to meet her in her office to get a better understanding of the inner workings of the government.
the-smell-of-drying-ink.location: Adeline's office in the Manor House

a-rewarding-choice.name: A Rewarding Choice
a-rewarding-choice.description: Adeline asked me to meet her in her office. She wants my help with an important choice as "an average Mistrian".
a-rewarding-choice.location: Adeline's office in the Manor House

chief-inspector.name: Chief Inspector
chief-inspector.description: Adeline asked me to come along for her next inspection of Mistria. We'll start from the Request Board.

lost-track-of-time.name: Lost Track of Time
lost-track-of-time.description: Adeline asked me to join her for tea. I hope she takes the time to actually relax...
lost-track-of-time.location: Adeline's office in the Manor House

a-craving.name: A Craving
a-craving.description: Adeline said she's been craving Lemon Pie. Anything to help her out!

tall,-dark-and-mysterious.name: Tall, Dark and Mysterious
tall,-dark-and-mysterious.description: Seeking help to unload supplies for the relief effort, paying 200t. Come talk to me.

an-open-book.name: An Open Book
an-open-book.description: Balor wants to give me advice on the items I'm shipping. I should go meet him in the Inn to hear him out.

lemonade-from-lemons.name: Lemonade From Lemons
lemonade-from-lemons.description:
Balor asked me to join him for a meal at the Inn.
Business must be good!

for-good.name: For Good
for-good.description: Balor asked me to meet him in his room at the Inn for a meal.

life-in-this-form.name: Life in This Form
life-in-this-form.description: Caldarus asked me to join him at his temple for a meal. What could he want to speak about?

the-unusual-seed.name: The Unusual Seed
the-unusual-seed.description: Celine has a question about a flower that she hopes I can help her with.

water-and-soil.name: Water and Soil
water-and-soil.description: Celine asked me to meet her at her cottage. The mystery seed hasn't sprouted yet and she wants my insight into what could possibly make this seed grow.

a-change-of-green-ery.name: A Change of Green-ery
a-change-of-green-ery.description: Celine says the she can't get the sprout to grow any more and wants to brainstorm what to do. Is there something special it needs?

a-lost-flower.name: A Lost Flower
a-lost-flower.description: Celine asked me to join her for a picnic! She wants to meet at her cottage first.

a-craving-2.name: A Craving
a-craving-2.description: Celine said she's been craving a Spring Salad. Anything to help her out!

a-new-blend.name: A New Blend
a-new-blend.description: Darcy asked me to meet her at the Sleeping Dragon Inn to try her new coffee blends.

the-stele.name: The Stele
the-stele.description: Eiland asked me to meet him at the Manor House. He wants to show me an "interesting" historical site on the grounds.

the-ruins.name: The Ruins
the-ruins.description: Eiland asked me to meet him at the Western Ruins to look for more clues and possibly more Dragonsworn Armor.

the-manor.name: The Manor
the-manor.description: Eiland says that the search for the Dragonsworn Armor has taken an unexpected turn. I should meet him at the manor.

the-glade.name: The Glade
the-glade.description: Eiland needs more time to find a lead on the Dragonsworn armor, but wants go for a walk in the Deep Woods. Maybe walking will clear his mind?

sweet-memories.name: Sweet Memories
sweet-memories.description: Elsie asked me to meet her in her room at the Manor House to discuss her memoirs.
sweet-memories.location: Elsie's room in the Manor House

a-mysterious-treasure.name: A Mysterious Treasure
a-mysterious-treasure.description: I've got an old chest gathering dust at the museum, and I just can't get it open. Could someone lend me a hand?

a-get-together.name: A Get Together
a-get-together.description: Hayden has invited me to a get together at his place.

extra-feed.name: Extra Feed
extra-feed.description: Hayden has some extra feed to give me and wants me to meet him at his farm. I wonder how Henrietta's doing...

real-fine-day.name: Real Fine Day
real-fine-day.description: Hayden says he has a day planed to help socialize Henrietta. Does the General Store let chickens inside... ?

a-little-while-longer.name: A Little While Longer
a-little-while-longer.description: Hayden asked me to come over so that we could spend some time together. I wonder what food he's making...

happy-anniversary.name: Happy Anniversary
happy-anniversary.description: Hemlock asked me to meet him at the Sleeping Dragon Inn to help plan a date night for Josephine.

josephine's-strays.name: Josephine's Strays
josephine's-strays.description:
I'm having trouble with a stray cat. I just cannot get the poor dear to come out of the stables.
Come talk to me and we'll come up with a plan!

becoming-juniper's-guinea-pig.name: Becoming Juniper's Guinea Pig
becoming-juniper's-guinea-pig.description:
Come and get your free health tonic at Juniper's Bathhouse!
Clears your pores, freshens your breath, and side effects are minimal.
Available while supplies last.

horsing-around.name: Horsing Around
horsing-around.description: Juniper wants to test another potion on me. I should go to the bathhouse before she tests it on someone else.

working-like-a-dog.name: Working Like a Dog
working-like-a-dog.description: Juniper asked me to come and help her with some "menial errands". How does Dozy put up with it...

potions-and-errands.name: Potions and Errands
potions-and-errands.description: Juniper asked me to bring her a Breath of Flame flower for a new bath infusion. Another errand?

a-craving-3.name: A Craving
a-craving-3.description: Juniper said she's been craving Pizza. Anything to help her out!

a-fine-discovery.name: A Fine Discovery
a-fine-discovery.description:
I believe I have discovered a way to attract a never before seen insect species.
Can I count on you to assist me? If so, meet me inside the Sleeping Dragon Inn.

surprise-me.name: Surprise Me
surprise-me.description: March asked to meet at the Blacksmiths without delay. No further explanation provided.

many-hands-make-light-work.name: Many Hands Make Light Work
many-hands-make-light-work.description: Olric asked me to come help him and March out with their work. March said my blacksmithing is improving but Olric wasn't supposed to tell me that...

shield-of-the-realm.name: Shield of the Realm
shield-of-the-realm.description: March asked me in a short letter to stop by if I wanted part-time work. How loquacious...

the-market-committee-election.name: The Market Committee Election
the-market-committee-election.description:
The Saturday Market Committee Election is upon us again! I'm seeking re-election as Chief Councilor and I'd love your help, [Player].
Meet me at the town square.

olric's-super-normal-dilemma.name: Olric's Super Normal Dilemma
olric's-super-normal-dilemma.description: Olric asked me to meet him at the Bathhouse to help him with a "super normal" situation.

pie-in-the-sky.name: Pie in the Sky
pie-in-the-sky.description: Reina asked me to come by the Inn when possible to try out a new dish of hers.

shopping-buddy.name: Shopping Buddy
shopping-buddy.description: Reina asked me to join her in the General Store. She's on the hunt for ingredients to wow the judges of the cooking competition.

farm-fresh-sous-chef.name: Farm Fresh Sous Chef
farm-fresh-sous-chef.description: Reina says she has something important she needs to ask me. I wonder if she's heard more about the Cooking Competition...

the-aldarian-cooking-contest.name: The Aldarian Cooking Contest
the-aldarian-cooking-contest.description: It's time! This is Reina's big moment in front of the judges for the Aldarian Cooking Contest.

a-craving-4.name: A Craving
a-craving-4.description: Reina said she's been craving an Ice Cream Sundae. Anything to help her out!

bird-song.name: Bird Song
bird-song.description: Landen asked me if I had any spare wood on the farm. He said to bring him 15 pieces for 150t!

a-sapling.name: A Sapling
a-sapling.description: Ryis wants me to meet him in his room to talk about a new tree for the cottage ruins. One step closer to a new birdhouse!

a-birdhouse.name: A Birdhouse
a-birdhouse.description: Ryis says the tree is ready for a birdhouse and asked me to come over to build it. What color should we paint it?

a-duet.name: A Duet
a-duet.description: Ryis says he spotted a blue feather by the birdhouse. I should meet him at the Hawthorn tree for some bird watching!

your-heart-desires.name: Your Heart Desires
your-heart-desires.description: Seridia asked me to meet her at her temple to discuss something privately. Does she want me to pay homage again?

a-craving-5.name: A Craving
a-craving-5.description: Seridia said she's been craving an Ice Cream Sundae. Anything to help her out!

a-heartfelt-apology.name: A Heartfelt Apology
a-heartfelt-apology.description: Taliferro asked me to meet him at the Sleeping Dragon Inn to give him a commoner's insight into crafting his apology.

the-big-one.name: The Big One
the-big-one.description: Terithia asked me to meet her at her shack to tell me about The Big One.

the-annual-check-up.name: The Annual Check-up
the-annual-check-up.description:
It's time for YOUR free annual check-up! Yes you, the person reading this.
Come to Valen's Clinic today for a healthier you!

batch-312.name: Batch 312
batch-312.description: Valen asked me to bring her one piece of peat for her research. I hope it's not for flavoring her medicine...

an-outside-consultant.name: An Outside Consultant
an-outside-consultant.description: Valen is struggling with her research into the panacea and wants to get Juniper's help. This might be tricky...

the-panacea.name: The Panacea
the-panacea.description: Valen asked me to meet her at the Western Ruins to search for the Cliffblossom. There are a lot of cliffs there, so hopefully it'll turn up...

a-craving-6.name: A Craving
a-craving-6.description: Valen said she's been craving a Grilled Cheese. Anything to help her out!

request-for-heather.name: Request for Heather
request-for-heather.description:
This time of year always makes me think of my mother's favorite flower, heather.
Could someone gather a few bunches for me?

request-for-a-lemon.name: Request for a Lemon
request-for-a-lemon.description:
I was planning to make some tea with lemon, but I'm short on lemons!
If you have an extra one, can you bring it to me? I'll teach you my recipe!

request-for-pineshrooms.name: Request for Pineshrooms
request-for-pineshrooms.description:
Would someone bring me some pineshrooms?
I'm really craving a nostalgic winter treat. If you don't mind bringing me some, I'll teach you how to make it!

request-for-a-silver-sword.name: Request for a Silver Sword
request-for-a-silver-sword.description:
My father, Baron Wiscar, has requested I send him something that he can give to the King.
I can't think of anything more suitable than a Silver Sword!

request-for-a-turnip.name: Request for a Turnip
request-for-a-turnip.description:
It's that time of year! I need to write a report on Mistria's spring crop yield.
Could you bring me a turnip to inspect?

request-for-an-iron-watering-can.name: Request for an Iron Watering Can
request-for-an-iron-watering-can.description: Our Iron Watering Can seems to have been misplaced, can I request someone craft me a new one?

request-for-a-mistril-ingot.name: Request for a Mistril Ingot
request-for-a-mistril-ingot.description: Despite filling out the proper forms, we've had a request by the Capital for a Mistril Ingot to confirm that it's a new metal.

request-for-an-apple.name: Request for an Apple
request-for-an-apple.description: Mistria's apples are second to none, I'd like to request one freshly picked from the tree.

request-for-a-copper-ingot.name: Request for a Copper Ingot
request-for-a-copper-ingot.description:
A trading partner wants to see the quality of the new copper coming out of the Mines.
Could I get a Copper Ingot?

request-for-an-emerald.name: Request for an Emerald
request-for-an-emerald.description:
The mines were once famous for the quality of their emeralds.
If you happen to find any, I'd pay handsomely.

request-for-gold-ore.name: Request for Gold Ore
request-for-gold-ore.description: I have it on good authority that the Mine is producing Gold Ore again. I'm paying handsomely to have some of that ore come directly to me.

request-for-a-ruby.name: Request for a Ruby
request-for-a-ruby.description:
I realize this is a big ask, but I have a customer who's willing to pay well for a ruby.
If you can get your hands on one, we can split the profits.

request-for-ultimate-feed.name: Request for Ultimate Feed
request-for-ultimate-feed.description: A friend of a friend has a horse that needs to be in tiptop shape for a race. I've been asked to procure Ultimate Large Animal Feed. You'll be well compensated for assisting me.

request-for-a-pink-diamond.name: Request for a Pink Diamond
request-for-a-pink-diamond.description: I'd quite like to get my hands on a Pink Diamond, if any are to be found in Mistria.

uncommon-pheromone-request.name: Uncommon Pheromone Request
uncommon-pheromone-request.description: I'd like to request a bottle of Uncommon Pheromone. If it works on bugs, maybe it could have applications in the perfume industry.
uncommon-pheromone-request.requirementsToReceive: Completed: Maple's Request for Common Pheromone

request-for-a-copper-shovel.name: Request for a Copper Shovel
request-for-a-copper-shovel.description:
I've saved up for a new Copper Shovel, but the Blacksmith's is so busy, I don't want to trouble them.
Could someone help me out?

request-for-coral.name: Request for Coral
request-for-coral.description:
I've read that ground up Coral can be good for growing certain types of plants.
Can someone bring me some?

request-for-fennel.name: Request for Fennel
request-for-fennel.description:
Can you bring me some fennel if you find any growing east of town?
I'll teach you how to make a spring salad in return!

request-for-gardening-materials.name: Request for Gardening Materials
request-for-gardening-materials.description:
Would someone bring me some sod and peat for a potting soil mix I'm testing?
I'll share some fresh flowers from my garden in return!
request-for-gardening-materials.requirementsToReceive:
Current Season: Spring
Obtained: Worn Pickaxe

request-for-a-shadow-flower.name: Request for a Shadow Flower
request-for-a-shadow-flower.description:
The Codex Mistria has some very interesting flowers it says are native to the region including a "Shadow Flower".
I'd like to have one to see how it grows!

request-for-spirit-mushroom-tea.name: Request for Spirit Mushroom Tea
request-for-spirit-mushroom-tea.description: Valen told me that Mistria has a tea I've never even heard of! Could I request a cup of Spirit Mushroom Tea, please?

request-for-walnuts.name: Request for Walnuts
request-for-walnuts.description: I love working with regional ingredients, could I request 3 Walnuts?

request-for-coconuts.name: Request for Coconuts
request-for-coconuts.description: Terithia told me that Mistria has Coconuts at the beach, but I haven't had the time to get out there myself. Could I request 3 Coconuts?

request-for-peaches.name: Request for Peaches
request-for-peaches.description: I've always enjoyed Peaches, and I thought it'd be fun to request some to experiment with in my drinks!

request-for-a-pomegranate.name: Request for a Pomegranate
request-for-a-pomegranate.description: I've really been craving a Pomegranate for some reason. Could anyone help me out?
request-for-a-pomegranate.requirementsToReceive:
Current Season: Winter
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"

request-for-legendary-honey.name: Request for Legendary Honey
request-for-legendary-honey.description: Has anyone heard of Legendary Honey? Supposedly even a single drop of it makes any dessert taste amazing! I gotta have a jar!

request-for-a-spell-fruit.name: Request for a Spell Fruit
request-for-a-spell-fruit.description: Have anyone ever seen a Spell Fruit? Celine told me about them from that old book of hers. I'd love to try one!

request-for-acorns.name: Request for Acorns
request-for-acorns.description: Celine read me a story about a princess befriending woodland creatures with a song. I can't sing, but I bet I could bribe them! Can I get some Acorns to help build my woodland army?

request-for-chestnuts.name: Request for Chestnuts
request-for-chestnuts.description:
URGENT: I need some chestnuts!
Please bring me some as soon as possible! I'll trade you an apple!

request-for-a-frog.name: Request for a Frog
request-for-a-frog.description:
Every fantasy story I read has a talking frog in it! There's too many in the Eastern Road's pond for me to check them all.
Help me start my big adventure!

request-for-iron.name: Request for Iron
request-for-iron.description:
Mister March said if I could bring him iron, he'd make me a sword!
I've been saving my allowance for forever to post this!

request-for-obsidian.name: Request for Obsidian
request-for-obsidian.description: Olric told me that Obsidian is cooled down lava! I want one! Someone get me one!

request-for-a-snail.name: Request for a Snail
request-for-a-snail.description:
Mom said I shouldn't keep catching snails to bring home, but she didn't say I couldn't put up a request for one!
Please help, I just need one more to complete the whole set!

request-for-a-crocus.name: Request for a Crocus
request-for-a-crocus.description: Could someone get me a Crocus? Please?

request-for-a-tidestone.name: Request for a Tidestone
request-for-a-tidestone.description: Dozy asked me to request someone bring him a "Tidestone" he thinks it'll be a real draw at the Bathhouse.

request-for-berries.name: Request for Berries
request-for-berries.description:
I'm craving something sweet!
If you bring me some wild berries, I'll teach you how to make berries and cream!

request-for-eggs.name: Request for Eggs
request-for-eggs.description:
Errol suggested that more protein in my diet could help with my excavation work.
May I request three eggs?

request-for-a-moon-fruit.name: Request for a Moon Fruit
request-for-a-moon-fruit.description:
Has anyone seen any Moon Fruit? They're quite hard to come by, but can be foraged around Mistria this time of year.
Please bring me one and I'll share a wonderful recipe for them!

request-for-shards.name: Request for Shards
request-for-shards.description:
I'm seeking some shards as part of my archaeological research. They can often be unearthed at dig sites!
If you come across any, could you bring me some?

request-for-a-strawberry.name: Request for a Strawberry
request-for-a-strawberry.description: Can someone bring me a strawberry? I'll share my recipe for strawberry shortcake as a reward!

request-for-a-strawberry-2.name: Request for a Strawberry
request-for-a-strawberry-2.description:
Would someone please bring me a strawberry?
I'm happy to share my recipe for strawberries and cream in return!

request-for-a-striped-bass.name: Request for a Striped Bass
request-for-a-striped-bass.description:
A fellow researcher has written to me with an unusual request for a Striped Bass from Mistria.
Could I prevail on someone to help me by catching one?

request-for-pudding.name: Request for Pudding
request-for-pudding.description: I recently read a treatise on Puddings, and now I can't stop thinking about them. May I request one?

request-for-a-pumpkin.name: Request for a Pumpkin
request-for-a-pumpkin.description: I'm quite fond of Pumpkin Pie, and would like to request a Pumpkin for one!

request-for-blackberries.name: Request for Blackberries
request-for-blackberries.description:
Could someone drop off some blackberries, please?
I just love blackberry jam but I'm nearly out. If you can bring me some, I'll teach you how to make your own!

request-for-an-orange.name: Request for an Orange
request-for-an-orange.description:
Would someone be a dear and fetch me an Orange? I need to make a fresh batch of my famous Marmalade.
I'd be happy to reveal the recipe to you in exchange.

request-for-a-silver-ingot.name: Request for a Silver Ingot
request-for-a-silver-ingot.description:
A personal friend in the Capital, who happens to be a rather famous jeweler, has been complaining about the silver shortage.
Please bring me a bar so I can make a gift of it.

request-for-a-snowdrop-anemone.name: Request for a Snowdrop Anemone
request-for-a-snowdrop-anemone.description: If you wouldn't mind bringing me one of those lovely flowers that grows by the Western Ruins, I can provide you with seeds to grow more.

request-for-wild-berries.name: Request for Wild Berries
request-for-wild-berries.description:
There are many ways to use the Mistrian Wild Berry, but in my opinion there's no finer way than in a fresh scone!
Bring me some wild berries and let me share the recipe with you.

request-for-roses.name: Request for Roses
request-for-roses.description: Could someone bring me a dozen Roses? I quite like the flower, but I'm not much of a fan of the actual picking, too many thorns.

request-for-berries-2.name: Request for Berries
request-for-berries-2.description: If someone would be so kind as to bring me some wild berries for my snack, I would be in your debt.

request-for-a-clam.name: Request for a Clam
request-for-a-clam.description:
Years ago Terithia showed me how to make the most delectable Clam Chowder, but I'm too old to be diving for the Clam I need off the coast.
Help a fellow out?

request-for-iron-armor.name: Request for Iron Armor
request-for-iron-armor.description:
Armor styles have changed greatly throughout Aldaria's history.
I would like to request Iron Armor crafted in the modern style for my research.

request-for-a-perch.name: Request for a Perch
request-for-a-perch.description:
I'm quite fond of Perch Risotto, but lack the fish.
If anyone is fishing in the river on a rainy day, please keep an eye out for it and bring one to me for the recipe.

request-for-a-tilapia.name: Request for a Tilapia
request-for-a-tilapia.description:
The Capital Museum has requested a Tilapia, but my skills do not lie in fishing.
There is a generous reimbursement if you can help.

request-for-a-scarecrow.name: Request for a Scarecrow
request-for-a-scarecrow.description: I'm afraid my patch of garden has become a breakfast spot to some very unruly birds. May I request a Scarecrow so my vegetables remain unharmed?

request-for-pears.name: Request for Pears
request-for-pears.description: May I request a brace of Pears? They make an excellent snack.

corrupted-mistril-sword-request.name: Corrupted Mistril Sword Request
corrupted-mistril-sword-request.description: There is a very old sword made of an unidentified type of metal in the Museum's backroom. I would like to request a Corrupted Mistril Sword to compare the two.

request-for-uncommon-bait.name: Request for Uncommon Bait
request-for-uncommon-bait.description: I have a dear friend who loves to fish, and am hoping to procure her some Uncommon Bait as a gift.
request-for-uncommon-bait.requirementsToReceive: Completed: Terithia's Request for Common Bait

request-for-baked-potato.name: Request for Baked Potato
request-for-baked-potato.description:
I have a theory I'd like to test, but I need some help!
Can someone bring me a baked potato? I think I can improve the recipe!

request-for-thorn-vine.name: Request for Thorn Vine
request-for-thorn-vine.description: Could I request some Thorn Vine? Could be a good deterrent to keep pests out of my field!

request-for-hay.name: Request for Hay
request-for-hay.description: I'd like to give my cows a little extra hay for being so good. I can swap it for some of their milk!

request-for-wood-fencing.name: Request for Wood Fencing
request-for-wood-fencing.description:
Could someone craft some wood fencing for me?
Henrietta's been testing the integrity of my current enclosure and it's simply not meeting her standards.

request-for-ultimate-feed-2.name: Request for Ultimate Feed
request-for-ultimate-feed-2.description: Henrietta was a big help with farm chores the other day and deserves a special treat. Could someone bring me a bag of Ultimate Small Animal Feed?

request-for-peas.name: Request for Peas
request-for-peas.description: Could I request some fresh Peas? Henrietta's a big fan!

request-for-blackberries-2.name: Request for Blackberries
request-for-blackberries-2.description: Anyone got any spare Blackberries? They make great feed for my animals!
request-for-blackberries-2.requirementsToReceive:
Current Season: Fall
Obtained: Any Animal

request-for-a-caterpillar.name: Request for a Caterpillar
request-for-a-caterpillar.description:
Luc's been asking me to get a friend for his caterpillar but I'm not sure where to get one.
Can someone bring me one? I'll repay you with a bite to eat!

request-for-a-catfish.name: Request for a Catfish
request-for-a-catfish.description: I need a catfish for a dish we're making at the inn! If you bring me one, I'll teach you my recipe!
request-for-a-catfish.requirementsToReceive:
Current Season: Spring
Obtained: Worn Fishing Rod

request-for-chestnuts-2.name: Request for Chestnuts
request-for-chestnuts-2.description:
This crisp weather has me in the mood for Roasted Chestnuts!
Bring me some and I'll share my recipe with you.

request-for-rice.name: Request for Rice
request-for-rice.description: When we have a really spicy dish I like to keep plenty of Rice on the table to help cut the heat for the kids. Can I request a couple of bags?

request-for-sapphire.name: Request for Sapphire
request-for-sapphire.description:
A friend went out of the way to do me a favor and I'd like to show him how much I appreciated it.
Could you find me a Sapphire?

request-for-sheep-wool.name: Request for Sheep Wool
request-for-sheep-wool.description:
We're placing an order for new blankets for the inn soon, and I think it'd make them extra special to be made of wool from Mistrian sheep.
I'll need half a dozen!

request-for-a-potted-plant.name: Request for a Potted Plant
request-for-a-potted-plant.description: Hard to keep plants around the Inn, since Luc keeps making them into his bug's habitats. Can I request a Potted Plant so he can have a designated place for them?

request-for-wild-grapes.name: Request for Wild Grapes
request-for-wild-grapes.description: Things around here are too busy to go foraging myself, so can someone please hunt down some Wild Grapes for me? Try the Narrows!

request-for-a-copper-net.name: Request for a Copper Net
request-for-a-copper-net.description: I'd like to surprise someone with a Copper Net! Can anyone make one for me?

request-for-a-beet.name: Request for a Beet
request-for-a-beet.description:
Winter's here and that means Beets!
I'd like to request the freshest, most mouthwatering Beet you can find!

request-for-bell-berry-bakewell-tart.name: Request for Bell Berry Bakewell Tart
request-for-bell-berry-bakewell-tart.description: Could someone whip me up a Bell Berry Bakewell Tart, now that the Deep Woods are opened back up?

request-for-tomatoes.name: Request for Tomatoes
request-for-tomatoes.description:
Would someone bring me some tomatoes?
I could really go for some nice cool gazpacho! I'll make enough for both of us!

request-for-a-goby.name: Request for a Goby
request-for-a-goby.description: Can I get someone to fish me up a Goby? They're good luck!

request-for-lake-trout.name: Request for Lake Trout
request-for-lake-trout.description: Can someone fish me up a Lake Trout from the Deep Woods?

request-for-a-monster-horn.name: Request for a Monster Horn
request-for-a-monster-horn.description: Now, I love to whittle, but I've been thinking of expanding out into other materials. Could I request a Monster Horn to practice on?

request-for-a-cabbage.name: Request for a Cabbage
request-for-a-cabbage.description: I'm requesting a fresh snacking Cabbage!

request-for-a-cauliflower.name: Request for a Cauliflower
request-for-a-cauliflower.description: Looking for the freshest, most delicious Cauliflower in Mistria!

request-for-sugar-cane.name: Request for Sugar Cane
request-for-sugar-cane.description: You wouldn't believe how hard it is to get Sugar Cane in Mistria! Could I request one?

request-for-ice.name: Request for Ice
request-for-ice.description:
You'd be amazed at how much ice we need to stock up on to keep our drinks cold and our food fresh!
Would you mind helping out?

request-for-rooster-feathers.name: Request for Rooster Feathers
request-for-rooster-feathers.description:
We could use some fresh Rooster Feathers to refill our guest pillows.
Could someone help us out?

request-for-salmon.name: Request for Salmon
request-for-salmon.description: If it's not too much trouble, could someone bring me some fresh salmon? Our last shipment was a little short.

request-for-trail-mix.name: Request for Trail Mix
request-for-trail-mix.description:
I like to keep plenty of Trail Mix on hand for the kids, but they sure eat a lot of it! Can someone mix some more up for me? You'll need Wild Berries and Water Chestnuts from the Narrows to make it!
Feel free to use the kitchen at the inn.

request-for-crystal-berries.name: Request for Crystal Berries
request-for-crystal-berries.description: I've heard of something called "Crystal Berries" that grow in Mistria, but I haven't been able to find any! Can I request some? I'd love to see what I can bake with them!

request-for-noodles.name: Request for Noodles
request-for-noodles.description: Maple keeps asking for Noodles, but then tells me "not these Noodles, the other ones!" I'm at my wit's end, can someone bring me a plateful to try to appease my little princess?

request-for-dill.name: Request for Dill
request-for-dill.description: Could I request some Dill? Can't make good Crab Cakes without it!

request-for-chili-peppers.name: Request for Chili Peppers
request-for-chili-peppers.description: Seems to me I'm always running out of Chili Peppers! I'd like to request a few.

request-for-capybara-bristles.name: Request for Capybara Bristles
request-for-capybara-bristles.description: You won't find a more comfortable stuffing for a chair than Capybara Bristles, which is why I require some.

request-for-crystals.name: Request for Crystals
request-for-crystals.description:
Rumor has it that crystals of marvelous quality can be found below the mines.
I would be willing to pay top tesserae for some.

request-for-a-duck-egg.name: Request for a Duck Egg
request-for-a-duck-egg.description: Dozy likes a duck egg in his food every now and then, bring one to me.

request-for-a-fog-orchid.name: Request for a Fog Orchid
request-for-a-fog-orchid.description:
Eiland claims he saw a "mystical, ethereal flower that seemed out of a bygone era" at the Western Ruins.
I've got better things to do then hunt for it, but if you find it, bring it to me.

request-for-monster-powder.name: Request for Monster Powder
request-for-monster-powder.description:
I've recently seen a curious new item called "monster powder" on the market.
I would like to investigate its uses. Bring some to me.
request-for-monster-powder.requirementsToReceive:
Unlocked The Mines
Obtained: Monster Powder

important-request-for-a-moon-fruit.name: Important Request for a Moon Fruit
important-request-for-a-moon-fruit.description:
I had no idea Mistria was so far out in the country that I'd need to bake my own Moon Fruit Cake.
Luckily Dozy has chef training. Would someone bring me a Moon Fruit?

request-for-a-red-toadstool.name: Request for a Red Toadstool
request-for-a-red-toadstool.description: I require a red toadstool for something I'm working on. I will not be elaborating.

request-for-water-chestnuts.name: Request for Water Chestnuts
request-for-water-chestnuts.description:
I keep seeing folks enjoying Water Chestnuts in all the ways but the best way- deep fried.
Bring me some and I'll enlighten you to the recipe.

request-for-a-monster-core.name: Request for a Monster Core
request-for-a-monster-core.description: Seeking a Monster Core to help settle an academic debate.

request-for-a-carrot.name: Request for a Carrot
request-for-a-carrot.description: Dozy quite enjoys a raw Carrot as a treat, and I'd like for him to have the very best. Gather me a few, or, uh grow them? I'm not sure.

request-for-a-night-queen.name: Request for a Night Queen
request-for-a-night-queen.description: Requesting a Night Queen flower. I need one for my work, but apparently they're quite rare, so I'm prepared to pay well.

request-for-rare-pheromone.name: Request for Rare Pheromone
request-for-rare-pheromone.description: I've had no luck hunting down a particularly rare bug, so I'd like to request a bottle of Rare Pheromone to assist.

request-for-voidite.name: Request for Voidite
request-for-voidite.description: Looking for Voidite. It's a theoretical "mineral" formed in unusual circumstances.

request-for-coconuts-2.name: Request for Coconuts
request-for-coconuts-2.description:
Would someone bring me some coconuts from the beach?
This weather calls for a nice cold drink. Bring me some and I'll fix us up some coconut milk!

request-for-glass.name: Request for Glass
request-for-glass.description:
It was hard enough to get glass before the earthquake, now it's near impossible!
I'll pay good money to whoever can find us some.

request-for-wood.name: Request for Wood
request-for-wood.description: Can someone bring me some wood to help us restock? I'll pay a fair price!

request-for-sap.name: Request for Sap
request-for-sap.description: I don't like dipping into the shop's supplies for personal projects. Can I request 5 Sap for my woodworking?

request-for-tomato-soup.name: Request for Tomato Soup
request-for-tomato-soup.description: Could I get a bowl of Tomato Soup? I've had it at the Inn, I've had it at the Capital, I want to try everyone's take on it!

request-for-rare-bait.name: Request for Rare Bait
request-for-rare-bait.description: Need someone who has got the know-how to get me some Rare Bait!
request-for-rare-bait.requirementsToReceive: Completed: Errol's Request for Uncommon Bait

request-for-a-silver-axe.name: Request for a Silver Axe
request-for-a-silver-axe.description: I don't know if I'm just getting older, or the trees are getting tougher, but I'd like to request a Silver Axe to even the odds!

request-for-rabbit-wool.name: Request for Rabbit Wool
request-for-rabbit-wool.description:
Rabbit Wool is essential for high quality garments, and one of my preferred materials to work in.
Please bring some to me!

request-for-a-monster-fang.name: Request for a Monster Fang
request-for-a-monster-fang.description: A customer of mine wants something unusual and daring to offset his new outfit. I'd like to request a Monster Fang to help in my design.
request-for-a-monster-fang.requirementsToReceive:
Unlocked The Mines
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"

request-for-a-middlemist.name: Request for a Middlemist
request-for-a-middlemist.description: I've heard rumors of Mistria's rarest flower, the Middlemist. Can anyone find one for me?
request-for-a-middlemist.requirementsToReceive:
Current Season: Spring
Reached Year 2
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"

request-for-holly.name: Request for Holly
request-for-holly.description: Could I request a few sprigs of Holly to decorate my booth with?
request-for-holly.requirementsToReceive:
Completed: "Greet the Vendors"
Current Season: Winter

request-for-copper-beetle.name: Request for Copper Beetle
request-for-copper-beetle.description: I've heard there's an amazing beetle found in the Mines... Please, I must have it for my collection! I'll trade for it!

request-for-dragon-horn-beetle.name: Request for Dragon Horn Beetle
request-for-dragon-horn-beetle.description: Have you ever heard of the Dragon Horn Beetle? I have! But I haven't been able to find one in the Deep Woods yet. Please help!

request-for-a-pond-skater.name: Request for a Pond Skater
request-for-a-pond-skater.description:
Mom says I can't keep trying to catch a Pond Skater, cause I keep falling into the water when I miss!
Can someone help me catch one?

request-for-cheese.name: Request for Cheese
request-for-cheese.description: Mom says I can't eat a big chunk of Cheese as a meal, but I can't think of any scientific reason why not. Could I request some Cheese, for science?

request-for-singing-katydid.name: Request for Singing Katydid
request-for-singing-katydid.description: Can someone help me catch a Singing Katydid? I want to put on a concert for all of my other bugs!

request-for-a-mullet.name: Request for a Mullet
request-for-a-mullet.description:
Miss Terithia told me there's a fish called a Mullet, and I don't believe it!
I'd cough up my favorite snack if someone proves me wrong!

request-for-a-seashell.name: Request for a Seashell
request-for-a-seashell.description:
If I'm going to become queen someday, I need to get more comfortable giving orders...
Bring me a pretty seashell... please!

request-for-a-freshwater-oyster.name: Request for a Freshwater Oyster
request-for-a-freshwater-oyster.description: Did you know that pearls come from oysters? I didn't! I can't afford a pearl, but I can request a Freshwater Oyster!

request-for-temple-flower.name: Request for Temple Flower
request-for-temple-flower.description: Did you know the Princess of Aldaria is really into flowers? It'd be cool to have a flower to talk to her about. Help me find a Temple Flower!

request-for-a-sunflower.name: Request for a Sunflower
request-for-a-sunflower.description: Sunflowers are so pretty, and they have so many seeds! I bet with just one I could make a whole FIELD of Sunflowers! Can I have one whole Sunflower, please?

request-for-common-pheromone.name: Request for Common Pheromone
request-for-common-pheromone.description:
Luc really likes finding new bugs, and he told me that the Pheromone stuff the Terrarium makes helps a lot!
So I want to request a Common Pheromone to give to him!

request-for-armored-bass.name: Request for Armored Bass
request-for-armored-bass.description: Terithia told me a legend of an Armored Bass, a fish that grows its own armor. Willing to pay well to see if it really exists.

request-for-copper.name: Request for Copper
request-for-copper.description: I need some copper ore and I need it soon. If you can manage it, I'll pay you for it.

request-for-freshwater-eel.name: Request for Freshwater Eel
request-for-freshwater-eel.description: I need a freshwater eel. Bring one to me if you want to know how to make a grilled eel rice bowl.

request-for-an-iron-ingot.name: Request for an Iron Ingot
request-for-an-iron-ingot.description:
Let's see how your blacksmithing is coming along, bring me an Iron Ingot.
Yes, [Player]. I'm talking to you.

request-for-a-monster-shell.name: Request for a Monster Shell
request-for-a-monster-shell.description:
I want to try forging something with these "monster shells" I've been seeing around.
I don't care to know where they come from, just bring me some.

request-for-silver-ore.name: Request for Silver Ore
request-for-silver-ore.description:
The prices for importing silver into Mistria are outrageous.

request-for-a-shipping-bin.name: Request for a Shipping Bin
request-for-a-shipping-bin.description: Can I request a Shipping Bin? We're running out of room at the Blacksmith's.

dragon-forged-bracelet-request.name: Dragon-Forged Bracelet Request
dragon-forged-bracelet-request.description: Eiland mentioned an ancient technique called "Dragon Forging" but couldn't remember where he read it. I'm requesting a Dragon Forged Bracelet, but I'm not sure it exists.

request-for-mistril-ore.name: Request for Mistril Ore

request-for-breath-of-flame.name: Request for Breath of Flame
request-for-breath-of-flame.description: I'm looking for a unique gift for Celine. I know it's a longshot, but can someone help me find a Breath Of Flame flower?

request-for-burdock-root.name: Request for Burdock Root

request-for-an-onion.name: Request for an Onion
request-for-an-onion.description:
I'm making my favorite Onion Soup, but I seem to be short on the most important ingredient.
Could someone bring me an Onion?

request-for-golden-butter.name: Request for Golden Butter
request-for-golden-butter.description: A Capital merchant with a high opinion of himself recently told me I couldn't expect something like Golden Butter out of Mistria. I'll pay handsomely to prove him wrong.

request-for-a-sweet-potato.name: Request for a Sweet Potato
request-for-a-sweet-potato.description: A Roasted Sweet Potato is especially good when the weather starts to turn cold. Can I request a Sweet Potato?

request-for-grilled-corn.name: Request for Grilled Corn
request-for-grilled-corn.description: A few ears of Grilled Corn would be a perfect summer side dish. Could someone grill them up for me?

request-for-corn.name: Request for Corn
request-for-corn.description: Grilled Corn is a regular side at our dinner table, but I don't want to dip into our shop's stock. I'd like to request 4 ears of corn.

request-for-diamond.name: Request for Diamond
request-for-diamond.description: Diamonds have a lot of industrial uses, but I just like'em cause they're shiny! Hard to find though, could someone bring me one?

request-for-a-miner's-pickaxe.name: Request for a Miner's Pickaxe
request-for-a-miner's-pickaxe.description:
When the earthquake hit, we lost a lot of our gear in the mines.
I found my pickaxe, but Errol never found his. I'd love to return it to him!

request-for-a-really-round-rock.name: Request for a Really Round Rock
request-for-a-really-round-rock.description:
I once saw an incredibly round rock in the mines, but it rolled out of sight before I could grab it!
If you see it, could you bring it to me?

request-for-a-rock.name: Request for a Rock
request-for-a-rock.description: Hi, can someone bring me a cool rock? I'm collecting them! I'll give you a nice chair in exchange.

request-for-a-pike.name: Request for a Pike
request-for-a-pike.description: Can I request a Pike? I hear fish is brain food, and I've never caught a pike so I figure they're pretty smart!

request-for-oyster-mushrooms.name: Request for Oyster Mushrooms
request-for-oyster-mushrooms.description: March never really liked Oyster Mushrooms when he was little, but maybe now that he's older he'll like them! Could someone find some for me?

request-for-berries-3.name: Request for Berries
request-for-berries-3.description:
I'm working on a pie recipe, but I need some fresh wild berries.
If you bring me some I'll teach it to you!

request-for-blueberries.name: Request for Blueberries
request-for-blueberries.description:
It's blueberry season, so I want to make some blueberry jam!
If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe!

request-for-broccoli.name: Request for Broccoli
request-for-broccoli.description:
Can I request some fresh broccoli?
There's a tough recipe I want to try out...

request-for-cod.name: Request for Cod
request-for-cod.description:
Anyone in the mood for a little ocean fishing?
I'm looking for a Cod, and I've got a recipe to share if you do!

request-for-a-deep-earthworm.name: Request for a Deep Earthworm
request-for-a-deep-earthworm.description:
Luc wants to see a bug he's never seen before!
Can you help me be a cool big sister and find an insect from deep in the mines?

request-for-milk.name: Request for Milk
request-for-milk.description:
I've been experimenting with ice cream recently, and that takes a lot of milk!
Bring me some and I'll let you try out one of my recipes!

request-for-rosemary.name: Request for Rosemary
request-for-rosemary.description: I think my Rosemary might be getting a bit old, could someone bring me a fresh sprig now that it's back in season?

request-for-wild-leek.name: Request for Wild Leek
request-for-wild-leek.description:
Could someone bring me a wild leek? I'm a little short for my soup recipe.
I'll give you a bowl to take home in return!

request-for-garlic.name: Request for Garlic
request-for-garlic.description:
Could someone please bring me some garlic?
Since garlic is in season, I'd love to make a batch of garlic bread. If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe!

request-for-butter.name: Request for Butter
request-for-butter.description: Any Chef will tell you that the one thing they can never have enough of is Butter! I'd like to request some.

request-for-deluxe-honey.name: Request for Deluxe Honey
request-for-deluxe-honey.description: Luc told me about Deluxe Honey and how only a hive of rare bees can make it! I'd love to try cooking with some!

request-for-bull-horns.name: Request for Bull Horns
request-for-bull-horns.description:
I've got some crafting orders that need Bull Horns to finish, but they're in short supply.
Can you help?

request-for-cranberries.name: Request for Cranberries
request-for-cranberries.description:
Would someone mind bringing me some cranberries?
This chilly weather has me craving a taste of home.
If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe for cranberry orange scones!

request-for-glowberries.name: Request for Glowberries
request-for-glowberries.description: Looking for someone to gather Glowberries for me, I'd like to make some cookies.

request-for-materials.name: Request for Materials
request-for-materials.description: I'm slightly short on materials for a project. Can anyone spare some wood and stone? I can pay, of course!

request-for-smallmouth-bass.name: Request for Smallmouth Bass
request-for-smallmouth-bass.description: My parents really like Mistrian Smallmouth bass. Can I request a couple to send them?

request-for-red-wine.name: Request for Red Wine
request-for-red-wine.description: You would think as a professional food judge I would have a dedicated sommelier, but no. I'd like to request a GOOD bottle of Red Wine.

request-for-beet-soup.description: If there was someone... who had made an exceptional Beet Soup, and was so inclined to make more... I'd be willing to pay handsomely.

request-for-bait.description: I could use a little extra help getting the fish to bite. Can someone bring me a worm?

request-for-an-earthshroom.name: Request for an Earthshroom
request-for-an-earthshroom.description:
Don't know if it's found around these parts, but I'm looking for an Earthshroom.
I got a recipe to exchange for it that'll make it worth the hunt!

request-for-ingredients.name: Request for Ingredients
request-for-ingredients.description:
It's salmon season again, and I'm craving some horseradish salmon!
If someone can bring me some key ingredients, I'll share my recipe!

request-for-trout.name: Request for Trout
request-for-trout.description:
I'm craving some smoked trout soup, but the fish aren't biting for me!
If you can bring me a trout I'll teach you my recipe!

request-for-underseaweed.name: Request for Underseaweed
request-for-underseaweed.description:
I like seaweed fine in a cooked dish, but not too much by itself.
Maybe I just haven't tried the right kind. Bring me some I haven't tried before!

request-for-tuna-sashimi.name: Request for Tuna Sashimi
request-for-tuna-sashimi.description: I've got a craving for Tuna Sashimi, but I just haven't had any luck with my catches! Can someone help out?

request-for-a-coelacanth.name: Request for a Coelacanth
request-for-a-coelacanth.description: You ever heard of the Coelacanth? They say it's a fish that's been around for pretty much forever. I've never caught one, but I'd love to see one!

request-for-common-bait.name: Request for Common Bait
request-for-common-bait.description: Little Luc was telling me that those new Terrariums thingies can produce Common Bait that helps attract fish. I'm not much for taking care of bugs, so I'd like to request one!

request-for-herbs.name: Request for Herbs
request-for-herbs.description:
Would someone please bring me some herbs?
I'm planning to make some herb salad but I'm a little short on ingredients.

request-for-a-morel-mushroom.name: Request for a Morel Mushroom
request-for-a-morel-mushroom.description:
I would like to source a morel mushroom, as it's known to have anti-inflammatory properties.
Please deliver one if possible.

request-for-rose-hips.name: Request for Rose Hips
request-for-rose-hips.description:
I would like to request some fresh rose hips so I can make some seasonal jam.
They can be found fruiting on rose bushes when the weather gets cold.
If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe for rose hip jam!

request-for-seaweed.name: Request for Seaweed
request-for-seaweed.description:
Would someone please deliver some seaweed?
This hot weather calls for a nice chilled seaweed salad. If you can bring me some, I'll share my recipe!

request-for-tea.name: Request for Tea
request-for-tea.description:
My favorite tea has been in short supply for ages now.
Could I request some local tea instead?

request-for-a-bird-house.name: Request for a Bird House
request-for-a-bird-house.description: I woke up to birdsong yesterday morning and quite enjoyed it. I'd like to request a Birdhouse to hopefully attract some new bird friends to my Clinic.

request-for-cucumbers.name: Request for Cucumbers
request-for-cucumbers.description: One of the joys of summer is fresh Cucumbers. Could I request a few?

request-for-premium-honey.name: Request for Premium Honey
request-for-premium-honey.description: I'm a bit of a Honey connoisseur, recently I read about a special Premium Honey but I can't seem to find any. Little help?

request-for-a-daikon-radish.name: Request for a Daikon Radish
request-for-a-daikon-radish.description:
As the name suggests, Winter Stew is just the thing for a frosty day in Mistria!
Bring me a Daikon Radish and I'll share my recipe with you.

request-for-sesame.name: Request for Sesame
request-for-sesame.description:
One of my favorite herbs in Mistria is the Sesame!
Bring me some and I'll show you a great dish to make with it.

request-for-pomegranate-juice.name: Request for Pomegranate Juice
request-for-pomegranate-juice.description: Can I request a glass of Pomegranate Juice? There's nothing more refreshing!

request-for-a-riceball.name: Request for a Riceball
request-for-a-riceball.description: I'd like to request a Riceball, I need something I can eat while working.

request-for-salted-watermelon.name: Request for Salted Watermelon
request-for-salted-watermelon.description: Can anyone in Mistria make me a Salted Watermelon? It's a perfect summer treat!

request-for-a-sushi-platter.description: May I request a Sushi Platter?

request-for-a-bomb.name: Request for a Bomb
request-for-a-bomb.description: There seems to be a type of Rockclod that possesses the remarkable ability to spit Bombs. I would like one. A Bomb, that is.

request-for-a-dragon-forged-core.name: Request for a Dragon-Forged Core
request-for-a-dragon-forged-core.description: I require a Dragon-Forged Core, to test out fluctuations in this era's ley lines.

request-for-a-fire-wasp.name: Request for a Fire Wasp
request-for-a-fire-wasp.description: Have you heard of a Fire Wasp? It sounds delightful! I would like to request one.

request-for-a-latte.name: Request for a Latte
request-for-a-latte.description: I wish to try the popular new drink called the "Latte".

request-for-mont-blanc.name: Request for Mont Blanc
request-for-mont-blanc.description: I would like to request the dessert known as "Mont Blanc".

request-for-void-stone.name: Request for Void Stone
request-for-void-stone.description: I may have punched a teeny tiny hole in space-time. I'd like to request 3 Void Stone. Quickly, please.

crown-request:-crops.name: Crown Request: Crops
crown-request:-crops.description: Not every place in Aldaria is as bountiful as Mistria, and fresh crops would go a long way to help out areas that are still struggling to recover after the earthquake.

crown-request:-tables-and-chairs.name: Crown Request: Tables and Chairs
crown-request:-tables-and-chairs.description:
The Capital is constructing a brand new orphanage, but has run into issues with not having enough woodworkers available.
Help supply new furniture so the children can be moved into their new home as quickly as possible.

crown-request:-mine-forageables.name: Crown Request: Mine Forageables
crown-request:-mine-forageables.description: The Royal Physician is requesting rare and unusual underground materials to see if any would be useful to his work.

crown-request:-fish.name: Crown Request: Fish
crown-request:-fish.description: Bad weather up the coast has kept fishing boats from sailing out. Shipments of fish would go a long way to help until the storms clear up.

crown-request:-berries.name: Crown Request: Berries
crown-request:-berries.description:
The Capital Market has put out a request for fresh berries. They're always in high demand!
I know it doesn't seem like much, but shipping out some berries would be a big help.

crown-request:-ingots.name: Crown Request: Ingots
crown-request:-ingots.description:
Quality metal ingots are vital for work all over Aldaria, but supply simply hasn't kept up with demand.
Shipping ingots would help projects that have stalled out.

crown-request:-animal-materials.name: Crown Request: Animal Materials
crown-request:-animal-materials.description: The Crown has requested an additional supply of feathers and wool to help make bedding and blankets for those in need.

crown-request:-soup.name: Crown Request: Soup
crown-request:-soup.description: The Capital's soup kitchen has requested regional soups to help replenish its larder.

crown-request:-stone.name: Crown Request: Stone
crown-request:-stone.description:
An old stone retaining wall recently collapsed along a well traveled road in the northeast.
The surveyors want to build it back even better, so as much stone as can be spared is requested.

crown-request:-archeology-shards.name: Crown Request: Archeology Shards
crown-request:-archeology-shards.description: The Capital Museum has requested local artifact shards from all around Alaria as it conducts a research project.

crown-request:-copper-tools.name: Crown Request: Copper Tools
crown-request:-copper-tools.description:
An increase in the number of farms being established across rural Aldaria has meant that copper tools are in high demand.
Shipping some out would help us support these newer farms.

crown-request:-golden-ingredients.name: Crown Request: Golden Ingredients
crown-request:-golden-ingredients.description:
There's no better way to show foreign dignitaries that Aldaria is back on its feet than to give them a meal made with all Aldarian ingredients!
But to do that, chefs in the Capital will need the very best.

crown-request:-baked-dishes.name: Crown Request: Baked Dishes
crown-request:-baked-dishes.description: The Crown has put out a request for hearty main dishes to be shipped out to villages in the Western Mountains of Aldaria, to help offset a poor harvest in the region.

crown-request:-stone-paths.name: Crown Request: Stone Paths
crown-request:-stone-paths.description: Repairs and upgrades to the roads of Aldaria is an ongoing task. Additional paving materials would help to speed up the work!

crown-request:-flowers.name: Crown Request: Flowers
crown-request:-flowers.description:
Princess Delaphine has heard that there are no finer flowers in Aldaria than in Mistria!
This is a special request to help supply the floral arrangements for her birthday celebration.

crown-request:-monster-materials.name: Crown Request: Monster Materials
crown-request:-monster-materials.description:
Linsberry Island has been reporting the appearance of unusually aggressive wildlife that the Capital has no previous record of.
They're issuing a call to see if anyone has physical examples of something similar in the kingdom.

crown-request:-grass-starters.name: Crown Request: Grass Starters
crown-request:-grass-starters.description: Grass Starters are needed to help combat topsoil erosion along the edge of the badlands.

crown-request:-refined-stone.name: Crown Request: Refined Stone
crown-request:-refined-stone.description: Shipments of Refined Stone from Mistria would help provide high quality materials for various building projects across the kingdom.

crown-request:-bell-berries.name: Crown Request: Bell Berries
crown-request:-bell-berries.description: The Crown believes it is important to assess the emerging specialties of its towns for export potential, and Bell Berries are one of Mistria's.

crown-request:-gold-ingots.name: Crown Request: Gold Ingots
crown-request:-gold-ingots.description: The Crown is searching for new sources of gold within Aldaria.

green-sapling-surprise.description:
A terrible fate awaits the people of this town...
Unless someone can defeat 20 Sapling Monsters!

rock-clod-catastrophe.name: Rock Clod Catastrophe
rock-clod-catastrophe.description: An unimaginably grim future can only be averted with the destruction of 20 Rock Clods.

mushroom-madness.name: Mushroom Madness
mushroom-madness.description:
Foul Mushrooms threaten to reduce the Kingdom to ruins.
Travel to the Tide Caverns and defeat 20 Green Mushrooms!

enchantern-explosion.name: Enchantern Explosion
enchantern-explosion.description: Venture into the Tide Caverns and slay 20 Blue Enchanterns before they bring Havoc to Aldaria!

staggering-stalagmites.name: Staggering Stalagmites
staggering-stalagmites.description:
In the Deep Earth biome, Green Stalagmites threaten to undermine all we hold dear.
Turn 10 Green Stalagmite monsters to gravel!

items.name: Stalagmite Spike Tile (page does not exist)

essence-gone-batty.name: Essence Gone Batty
essence-gone-batty.description:
Head to the Deep Earth biome and set your sights on Blue Essence Bats.
Only when 20 have been slain will Mistria be safe!

items.name: Essence Bat Garland (page does not exist)

malicious-mimics.name: Malicious Mimics
malicious-mimics.description: Aldaria's good fortunes will change for the worse, unless 5 Mimics are defeated in the Mines.

items.name: Mimic Storage Chest (page does not exist)

flame-spirit-shocker.name: Flame Spirit Shocker
flame-spirit-shocker.description: Take care not to be burned while you hunt down 20 Flame Spirits in the Lava Caves.

items.name: Flame Spirit Lamp (page does not exist)

lava-cat-conundrum.name: Lava Cat Conundrum
lava-cat-conundrum.description: Lava Cats. Cute, but deadly. Fall not for their feline charms, but instead head to the Lava Caves and defeat 20 of them!

items.name: Lava Cat Double Bed (page does not exist)

flying-tome-trouble.name: Flying Tome Trouble
flying-tome-trouble.description:
In the Ruins, the Flying Tomes tempt adventurers with their forbidden knowledge.
Turn 20 of them into confetti!

items.name: Floating Tome Lamp (page does not exist)

rock-stack-smackdown.name: Rock Stack Smackdown
rock-stack-smackdown.description:
Rock Stacks. An uncanny alliance between monsters, that can only lead to the mortal world being crushed beneath them.
Journey down to the Ruins and break apart 20 Rock Stacks!

items.name: Rock Stack Shelf (page does not exist)

gryphon-grapple.name: Gryphon Grapple
gryphon-grapple.description:
A conspiracy of Griffin Statues threatens all we hold dear, unless they are annihilated.
Defeat 10 Gryphon Statues in the Ruins!
